chapter: F09 — FM Chapter 9: Management of Working Capital
note: Official questions mapped to FM Chapter 9 (Management of Working Capital), the six-unit chapter that carries 68 register headings. Primary code first. Four placement rules were applied and are worth stating. (1) A question that computes the working-capital components from ratios alone, without an operating cycle or a cash-cost statement, is ratio analysis and belongs to FM Ch 3, not here — so SA-J25 Case Scenario II (VP Ltd), SA-J26 Q1(a) (AIL Limited, which ends in a Basic Defense Interval), SA-J26 Q4(c)-OR (BEE Ltd current-ratio impact table), MTP-J26-S2 Q1(a) (velocity ratios), MTP-S24-S1 Q1(a) (Ananya Limited) and MTP-S26-S2's Part I case (Solstice Biotech) are all excluded and recorded in the Chapter 3 back-fill list instead. (2) SA-J25 MCQ 8 (JKL Company, a contingency provision computed on working capital) is included, because the provision for contingencies is a Chapter 9 §5 step, not a ratio. (3) RTP-J26 Q11(b) (spontaneous sources of finance) was already placed in FM Ch 2 under F02.22 Short-term Sources of Finance, which covers the same ground as §27.1 here; it is left where it is and cross-referenced from the §27.1 block rather than moved out of a merged chapter. (4) MTP-M26-S1 Q1(b) is CAPM and MTP-M26-S1's buyback question is capital structure; neither is here despite matching a keyword. Case-scenario MCQ sets are recorded as one atom using the first MCQ's id.
